drafter.private_reasoning: The opposing counsel is pressing for confirmation that our search and production efforts cover all sources within Defendant's possession, custody, or control, and that all withheld documents (regardless of claimed relevance or burden) will be logged. Their request essentially demands an agreement that goes beyond the Federal Rules by requiring identification and logging of every single document withheld, not only those on privilege grounds, and does not acknowledge reasonable limits on proportionality, relevance, or burden. I should reinforce Defendant's commitment to compliance with the Rules but clarify that we will not log documents withheld solely on objections other than privilege, and our search will be reasonable and proportional as required under the Rules, not limitless. The draft responses should be revised for clarity and to avoid inadvertently waiving proportionality or relevance objections as required by Rule 26(b)(1). This will advance our client’s position and ensure efficiency.

Defendant's responses are subject to these qualifications.

Best regards,
Aldous Finch LLP
